Thanks — I reviewed the Elmbridge MSA you sent. High-level legal plan and asks:

1) Evidence: please provide point-of-contact for security questionnaire and the SOC 2 Type II report (we can accept via secure share). If possible, send links or the contact: security@elmbridge.ai.

2) Signature authority: we need the full legal entity name and confirmation of signatory authority. If the signatory is signing on behalf of a holding company, please indicate that and provide the entity that will be invoiced.

3) Redline approach:
   - We will accept most commercial edits; we aim to preserve our liability cap (standard = 1x annual fees) and IP carve-outs.
   - We will propose narrow revisions on indemnities and a small addition to the data residency clause to reflect US-only processing if requested.

4) Timeline & deliverables:
   - Kimberly to deliver a tracked MSA redline within 72 hours after we confirm party details and SOW.
   - Legal to return a negotiated redline within 5 business days thereafter unless there are material disagreements.

5) Attachments: we have a short redline guidance doc for customers (redline-instructions.pdf) — it explains what slows the process (e.g., adding broad carve-outs, wholesale IP swaps).

If Elmbridge can confirm the counterparty entity and provide the SOW or a draft SOW by EOD tomorrow, we will prioritize this and stick to the accelerated timeline.

Regards,
